name: @bft/transit
description: BrisbaneTransit: the Mode Tabs shell (Ferry | Train | Bus | Nearby | My Transit) built from the standalone apps' screens, plus "Around you" and the Ask box. React Router 8 framework mode on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.typegen: react-router typegen && pnpm --filter @bft/ferry --filter @bft/train --filter @bft/bus exec react-router typegen
scripts.deploy:staging: BUILD_SHA=$(node ../../scripts/build-sha.mjs) && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging pnpm build && wrangler deploy --var BUILD_SHA:$BUILD_SHA
scripts.deploy:production-preview: BUILD_SHA=$(node ../../scripts/build-sha.mjs) && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production-preview pnpm build && wrangler deploy --var BUILD_SHA:$BUILD_SHA
scripts.deploy:production: BUILD_SHA=$(node ../../scripts/build-sha.mjs) && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production pnpm build && wrangler deploy --var BUILD_SHA:$BUILD_SHA
